liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Ken Kesey interviewed by Frank Fey** (3 reviews, 1 other source): The Ken Kesey interview opening the recording is singled out as interesting; Reviewer calls the Kesey interview fantastic [1][2][7][9]
- **Ken Babbs and harmonica** (1 review): Ken Babbs plays loud harmonica [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **Ken Kesey interviewed by Frank Fey**: rare: 3 archived performances [11]
- **Ken Babbs and harmonica**: rare: 3 archived performances [11]
- **Take Two: Ken Kesey**: rare: 3 archived performances [11]
- **Bull**: rare: 3 archived performances [11]
- **Peggy The Pistol**: rare: 3 archived performances [11]
- **One-way Ticket**: rare: 3 archived performances [11]
- **Bells and Fairies**: rare: 3 archived performances [11]
- **Levitation**: rare: 3 archived performances [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1966-01-29.sbd.bershaw.5411.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 10 songs; 33 min; rated 3.44/5 by 9 [1]

## Around the show

- Presented as one of the old Acid Test recordings available on the site [2]
- Other Acid Tests had better spirit than this one, which is regarded as a novelty [6]
- Described as Acid Test 8 of 17 per Wikipedia, more defined than earlier Tests but not over the top [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1966-01-29.sbd.bershaw.5411.shnf**: transferred by Alan Bershaw; source: Soundboard [1]
